scope: Theorem 1.1 (Uniform bi-Hölder transport) of the manuscript “Uniform Bi-Holder Transport from Weak MTW” (preprints/Uniform-Bi-Holder-Transport-from-Weak-MTW-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 360 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1e1a412dff1dd263), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix (M, g) as above and 0 < λ ≤ Λ < ∞ for which the following density class is nonempty. There are α ∈ (0, 1] and C < ∞, depending only on (M, g), λ, Λ, such that the following holds for every pair of measurable densities satisfying Z M ρi d vol = 1, λ ≤ ρi ≤ Λ vol -almost everywhere, i = 0, 1. The almost-everywhere unique optimal map from ρ0 vol to ρ1 vol for the cost c has a homeomorphic representative e T : M → M, and d( e T(x), e T(x′ )) ≤ Cd(x, x′ )α , d( e T−1 (y), e T−1 (y′ )) ≤ Cd(y, y′ )α for all x, x′, y, y′ ∈ M.
